social_circle.name: Maya Williams

demographics.occupation: Graduate certificate student in counseling; part-time student support worker
demographics.education: Bachelor's degree; finishing a graduate certificate in counseling

background.how_they_met: Joshua and Maya grew up together as siblings in their parents' Long Beach household.
background.why_close: They share family history, Long Beach roots, progressive values, and an emotionally direct sibling dynamic. Maya is Joshua's first call when something important happens because she listens without rushing to fix him.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast, casual texts with jokes, check-ins, and blunt but caring advice. She uses short messages, occasional emoji, and practical prompts when Joshua spirals.

shared_activities: occasional overnight stays at Joshua's apartment
recent_text_topics: Checking on Joshua during heavy grading weeks and asking whether he ate, slept, or took a break.
Family updates about their grandmother Lillian's appointments and whether someone needs to drive her.
Jokes, memes, and quick commentary about family, politics, dating, and Joshua overworking.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Maya is Joshua's 23-year-old younger sister and that they text almost every day. Q05 also says Joshua usually calls his sister first because she answers quickly and listens without immediately fixing it. Q44 describes Maya helping Joshua through a rough night by telling him to eat, shower, and send the three things that had to happen the next day.

social_circle.name: Angela Williams

background.how_they_met: Angela is Joshua's mother and raised him in a structured Long Beach household.
background.why_close: Angela shaped Joshua's discipline and organization. They remain geographically close, see each other often, and coordinate family responsibilities.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Clear, practical texts with full sentences. She checks details, confirms plans, and notices when Joshua is stretched too thin.

recent_text_topics: Sunday dinner plans, grocery needs, and whether Joshua is coming by after church.
Shared calendar details for Lillian's medical appointments and medication pickups.
Reminders about rest, bills, car maintenance, and not letting work take over his whole week.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Joshua's parents Angela and Darryl live in Long Beach nearby and that he usually sees them on Sundays. Q01 says his mother worked in the school district and shaped his discipline. Q40 says his mom keeps track of most family appointments, with Joshua helping through shared calendars.
